title: NQuery project file
description: Declares the language server host for every .nql/.nqe file in this folder and its subfolders.

host.description: How to launch this project's language server.

args.description: Arguments passed to the executable. Supports the same variables as `command`.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the project file's folder.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the server process.

transport.description: How the client talks to the server.

settings.description: Opaque, application-specific configuration. The extension never inspects this; it is forwarded verbatim to the server as initializationOptions.
